reconcile.note: Clarke treats the angels named in Galatians as mere instruments transmitting a law that still originated with God, keeping Moses as human mediator.

sides.snippet: Yahweh came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. Yahweh called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.
sides.verseText: Yahweh came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. Yahweh called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.

sides.snippet: It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.
sides.verseText: What then is the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the seed should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.
